description: Rename a backup, or lock/unlock it. A locked backup is never deleted automatically when the backup quota fills up, and cannot be deleted until it is unlocked; its size still counts toward the quota. Pass `name`, `locked`, or both. Call list_backups first to get the backup id. This does not change the backup's contents.

backup_id.description: Id of the backup to change, from list_backups.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

locked.description: true to lock the backup so it is kept, false to unlock it so it can be deleted (automatically, when the quota fills, or by delete_backup).

name.description: New name for the backup (1-64 characters).

name: update_backup
title: Update Backup
